  content = '## The MCU''s Forgotten Chapter; The Incredible Hulk holds a unique place in MCU history. With only a handful known to exist, any authenticated Norton auto could become a five-figure card as MCU nostalgia grows.',

Norton rarely signs, making authenticated autos potential five-figure cards; - **Incredible Hulk #181 (1974 Comic)** — First appearance of Wolverine. CGC 9.8 copies sell for $30,000+; - **2014 Upper Deck Marvel Premier Hulk Sketch Cards** — Original art cards featuring the Green Goliath; - **Abomination Villain Cards** — Renewed interest after Shang-Chi and She-Hulk appearances',
  metaDescription = 'The Incredible Hulk (2008) complete guide — box office breakdown, cast spotlight, trading card market analysis, key cards to collect, and why this forgotten MCU chapter matters for collectors.',

Norton wanted a darker, more character-driven film while Marvel prioritized action and MCU connectivity. Mark Ruffalo took over starting with The Avengers (2012)."}, {"question": "How much did The Incredible Hulk make at the box office?", "answer": "The Incredible Hulk grossed $264.8 million worldwide against a $150 million budget. The 2008 Rittenhouse preview set (limited to 999) and Incredible Hulk #181 comic (first Wolverine appearance, $30,000+ in CGC 9.8) are top collectibles."}]',
  verdict = 'Often dismissed as the MCU''s weakest link, The Incredible Hulk is actually a solid action film that planted seeds still paying off 17 years later. Essential viewing for completionists and a goldmine for card collectors who know where to look.',
